compute_similarity_transform: compute a similarity transform (rotation, translation, scale) that aligns 3D points S1 to S2 using orthogonal Procrustes
compute_similarity_transform_batch: compute similarity transforms for a batch of 3D point sets S1 aligned to corresponding sets S2
reconstruction_error: compute the mean per-joint reconstruction error after Procrustes alignment between two sets of 3D keypoints
reconstruction_error_fromMesh: compute reconstruction error from 3D mesh vertices by regressing joints and aligning predicted to ground truth keypoints
review_pose_utils: review the pose_utils module for Procrustes alignment, batch similarity transforms, and mesh-based reconstruction error functions
